name: Vix
summary: Vix is a keyboard-friendly terminal text editor (a "Simple Terminal Rust IDE") built on ratatui: a thin App shell (package vix-tui in tui/, building the vix command) over 146 focused vix-* member crates in a Cargo workspace (edition 2024), with desktop GUIs in gui/.
description: Development is specification-driven: each crate owns a spec at crates/<crate>/spec/index.md; cross-cutting and app-level specs live under spec/. When behavior and spec disagree, decide which is correct and make them match. AGENTS.md is the canonical entry point for both human and AI contributors — read it first. The workspace version is 2.0.0 (unreleased; the latest published release is 1.8.0).
license: Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR MIT OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only
